about_short_description.short_description: BlockScore provides real-time identity verification services.

product.name: Cognito Flow
product.description: An ID verification system that integrates various methods to verify customer identities, including database checks, document verification, and selfie verification.

product.name: Cognito Screening
product.description: A compliance solution that screens customers against global watchlists and PEPs to ensure AML compliance, with features to reduce false positives and manage cases.

product.name: Identity Verification
product.description: Starts with a phone number for frictionless ID verification, leveraging phone ID link, fraud detection, and optimized user experience for high match rates.

product.name: Business Verification
product.description: Verifies business entities in real-time, checking incorporation, officers, addresses, and risk categories, with a focus on automation and workflow efficiency.

product.name: Address Verification
product.description: Validates and verifies customer addresses using data from authoritative sources, designed for industries requiring accurate address information for KYC/AML checks.

product.name: Age Verification
product.description: Verifies the age of customers purchasing age-restricted products by cross-referencing reliable data sources with minimal customer input required.
